Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to organize and return to the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on most. Instead of rebuilding a view every time you open a project, save it once and jump back in with a single click.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team already has access. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from daily task lists to quarterly planning boards. Once you have a view set up, you can share it with your team so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own.

We built this feature based on requests from customers who wanted a simpler way to manage recurring workflows without losing context between projects. Give it a try and see how much time it saves your team each week.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
